name: Upsolve AI
long_description: Upsolve AI is the analytics platform for deploying governed, grounded, and trustworthy data agents that know your business. Data teams use Upsolve's Agent Studio to get to AI-ready data foundations fast, unify and curate their context layer, and test, tune and monitor their Upsolve Data Agent to their benchmark. The company is founded by Ka Ling Wu and Serguei Balanovich, who built a similar product at Palantir before (featured in Palantir's S-1), growing it to 50+ enterprise customers and 8-figures of annual revenue in 2 years.

launches.title: 🐳 Upsolve AI - Agent Studio for Data Team
launches.tagline: Deploy trustworthy and governed analytics agent that know your business and data.
launches.body:
**🏆 TL;DR:** Upsolve AI is context infrastructure for analytics agents. We help data teams ship analytics agents that non-technical users actually trust. Agents that pull the _right_ numbers and explain them in your business's context, not just generate plausible SQL. If you've ever tried to put an analytics agent in front of your team and quietly killed it after it gave two different answers to the same question, this is for you.

<https://youtu.be/2bXZb6D-cNA>

## ❌ **The Problem**

"Let's just build an analytics agent." Every data team drowning in requests has this thought. The beta feels like magic until a non-technical user asks the same question three times and gets two different answers. Trust dies. The project quietly joins the 95% of AI POCs that never reach production.

You already know it's not the model, GPT and Claude write fine SQL. The model just has no idea how _your_ business works:

* **Governance and permission can't live in a prompt.** You can't trust an LLM to implement row- and column-level access or enforce who sees what. Without governance that an agent can't override, you can't put it in front of anyone outside the data team.
* **It pulls the wrong data and joins the wrong tables.** “gross_revenue” vs “net_revenue”, “customers” vs “users”. A semantic layer problem dressed up as a text-to-SQL one.
* **Technically correct, practically wrong.** Your fiscal year ends in March, not December. The number is "correct" and still useless.
* **Your semantic layer and context goes stale.** "User" got redefined twice since you scoped the project. Your semantic layer and context didn't keep up.
* **No observability, no improvement.** If you can't trace and root-cause a bad answer, you can't improve it.

These aren't LLM model problems. They're context problems, and context lives in docs, Slack threads, validated SQL from 2021, and your analysts' heads. No amount of SQL generation skill recovers it.

## ⚒️ What Agent Studio gives you

A builder surface to encode context across three layers: **Structure** (schema, lineage, semantic model), **Meaning** (metrics, KPIs, business rules), and **Trust** (verified answers, usage signals, golden sets), then deploy and tune against it:

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=103717&key=user_uploads/1148602/44acebc6-4f8c-4fb2-86e0-cc9959bbd2df)

* **Software-defined, granular permissioning** baked into the data model, enforced beneath the agent.
* **A self-updating context layer** that captures institutional knowledge across your files and systems, so metric redefinitions and new launches don't silently break answers.
* **End-to-end tracing, an eval harness, and a staging sandbox**. Golden query sets and LLM-as-judge scoring before a single user sees an answer, plus prompt and SQL provenance for every response in production.
* **A compounding accuracy loop**. Wrong answers and poor behavior get flagged from real conversations and fed back, so the agent gets _more_ trustworthy over time.

**End result:** No existing semantic model required to start. Your team deploys analytics agents they don't have to babysit, and your non-technical users get answers they trust, wherever they already work (Slack, your product, internal portal, or any MCP surface).

Teams hit production-grade eval accuracy, clear 60–80% of their ad-hoc backlog in 7 days, and move stakeholders from a 3–5 day queue to answers in seconds.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=103717&key=user_uploads/1148602/79a3a29c-482f-4119-92f5-38612bd34bdb)

## 🤝 Why trust us

We’re already in production with Fortune 500 users, 100+ person BI teams, and growth-stage companies. We are the team that built HyperAuto at Palantir, and encoding messy institutional context into systems is the problem we've spent years on.

## 🙏 Our ask

This is for you if you own a data or BI function and you're either:

* Drowning in ad-hoc requests, where **repeat questions eat your analysts' week** and a generic GPT-on-the-warehouse attempt already fizzled, or
* A **B2B SaaS team whose customers keep asking for deeper analytics and insights** and you don't want to spend two quarters of engineering effort building it.

If you're a Head of Data, BI lead, analytics engineer, or VP Product who lives this, [**book a demo here**](https://calendly.com/kaling-aqk/upsolve-initial-exploration) or reach me directly at [kaling.wu@upsolve.ai](mailto:kaling.wu@upsolve.ai). We'll stand up a POC against your real data warehouse, not a sandbox.

launches.title: 🐳 Upsolve AI - Embed GenBI in Your App
launches.tagline: Spoil your users with hyper-personalized customer-facing analytics and insights that adapt on demand and “Just-Works”.
launches.body:
# 🏆 **TL;DR**

Generic dashboards in SAAS platform suck. Some might even say they’re dead.

But nearly all SaaS apps need a dashboard to show proof of value to stakeholders. With [Upsolve AI](https://upsolve.ai/), delight your end users with customer-facing analytics that “Just Works”, Make them want to use the analytics and love your product more.

Once you Upsolve your platform with our GenBI solution, your end users get to access adaptive and hyper-personalized analytics simply by telling your platform their persona and what kind of KPIs they care the most. They can easily drill down into the data at the speed of thought via natural language prompting. Our AI also interprets the data and provides guided insights, shedding light on what matters the most. Our AI can then investigate the data further, provide additional insights to optimize decision making.

# **🤨 Problem - Generic Dashboards in SaaS apps suck.**

🗺️ Can you imagine planning a cross-continent trip with nothing but a paper map?

⁉️ "Duh." Of course not.

😵‍💫 Yet this is precisely what SaaS users endure with traditional dashboards every day. They're like paper maps showing only major highways and cities—filled with generic metrics and charts that, for the most part, have zero relevance to your customer’s unique destination.

**Users get no value out of generic dashboards.** CFO, Regional directors and store managers stare at identical metrics in your expensive SaaS platform that took months to implement. Both search for answers to different questions to achieve different objectives. Both get lost. Their mission controls shouldn’t look the same.

**Your teams feel this pain too.** They’ve heard “can you get this chart for me?” from their end users way too many times. Visionaries become data query processors right when product innovation matters most. You end up building the infamous “Download CSV” button in your product or exposing an API to allow your customer to extract a data cut. As a result, you lose in-product user engagement prematurely.

**Dashboards should give the end user that “it gets me” feeling without the overhead.** It should create moments of delight and clarity that elevate decision-making from burden to superpower. It should be part of the reason your customers choose your product. It should turn your customers into your advocates.

# **💡 Solution - With Upsolve AI, you demonstrate and enhance your value to customers**

In a world of paper-map dashboards, Upsolve delivers the magic of Modern Map Apps for your customers' data to your end users. Give each end-user intelligent dashboards tailored to their goals and objectives, real-time alerts, and highlighting trends and insights worth doing something about— an all-in-one experience that transforms static metrics into operational brilliance. [Watch the demo video below](https://youtu.be/K6GiczydAQI):

We’re ready to power your customer-facing analytics and give your users those “aha!” moments with our AI features below:

1. **AI Report Generator: Adaptive, Hyper-personalized Analytics and Dashboard** 🪄\
   Give every end user that bespoke experience they deserve. Upsolve’s next-gen dashboard spins up analytics and interfaces dynamically based on user’s unique role, surfacing precisely the KPIs that drive decisions, at the right time.

   ![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=89121&key=user_uploads/1148602/9fb2c6dd-b242-44fd-9995-6aba0933bdb2)

2. **AI Drill Down: Natural Language Slice & Dice**\
   Built to make data-driven decision more accessible to less tech-savvy users. Applying 5 filters? Text to SQL? Skip these all together. Let you users query in natural language and watch the magic happen at the speed of thought.

   ![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=89121&key=user_uploads/1148602/6fe57514-06d4-44d2-b1ff-4d78ec735a1e)

3. **AI-Guided Insights: Interpretation**\
   An AI that picks up the signs for you 🎏 Upsolve flags important data signals and anomalies and push alerts to the user automatically, with no need to set up any automations up front.

   ![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=89121&key=user_uploads/1148602/c946ad6b-36bc-4f63-bfb7-e732ede6178b)

4. **AI-powered Investigation: Great analysts identify what users DIDN’T ask for but what they actually need**\
   Upsolve connects the dots, spots the trends, and asks questions you didn’t even think of to get the big “whys” answered. Guide your team’s decisions with AI-powered nudges.

   ![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=89121&key=user_uploads/1148602/26a6d178-c603-4cc0-aeab-0df6614289a0)


Give your users a dashboard, along with a customer success manager, AND a data analyst that proactively provides intelligence without them asking. That’s Upsolve AI, the all-in-one data experience your customers deserve, without you lifting a finger.

# **🙏 Ask**

Tempted to Upsolve your product and embed GenBI in your product? Grab a time slot [here](https://calendly.com/kaling-aqk/upsolve-initial-exploration) with us today or reach us at kaling.wu@upsolve.ai!

launches.tagline: Allow yours users to build and customize their dashboards and reports within your platform.
launches.body:
🏆 **TLDR**\
[Upsolve AI](https://upsolve.ai/) allows you to build and deliver customer-facing analytics to your end-users via an embeddable dashboard.

We’ve just released our newest feature: **Personal Workspace for dashboards. This allows your end users to build their own dashboards and reports within your product.** Your users no longer need to wait for your customer success manager or product team to get the metrics or reports they need! 📈

Some examples of how our customers enable their end users with this Upsolve feature:

* An expense management platform allows their end users to build out customized receipt audit reports
* An AI observability platform enables their solution engineers and enterprise customers to build tailored observability metrics report
* A supply chain risk management platform empowers their Fortune 500 customers to build out targeted supply chain visibility dashboard

**🤨 Problem**\
Most B2B SaaS companies need to build dashboards. [**A true dashboard communicates your product value to all stakeholders of your customers, even — and especially — those who never use the app.**](https://www.saastr.com/want-go-upmarket-need-great-dashboard/) This is especially true for enterprise software.

However, most, if not all, traditional dashboards failed to achieve this. Traditional dashboards are highly restrictive. Customers cannot customize the dashboard to fully understand their unique state of the world. This leads to frequent ad-hoc data cuts and reporting requests, causing operational friction with your customer support, product, and engineering teams. What’s worse, this means your users can’t get their questions answered right away, resulting in a subpar product experience.

**💡 Solution - Personal Dashboard Workspace**\
“Upsolve your product” by embedding our component in your product. Your users gain the superpower to build out their own version of dashboards, either by building them from a blank canvas or by modifying the dashboard template you ship out. [Watch the demo below](https://youtu.be/hj7VJSC_LyU?feature=shared):

1. Chart Explorer:\
   Your end users will now have access to all the verified/published charts your organization has provided. This means you can produce dozens of charts but leave it up to your end users to choose which of these charts they actually care to see and in which positions on their dashboard.

   ![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=84312&key=user_uploads/1148602/09a4f16d-2f03-40e2-96b8-07e272beedd4)

2. Point and Click Builder:\
   If none of the published charts are good enough for your end users' use cases, your end users can access a point-and-click chart builder. Any charts they produce will be surfaced back to you for potential reuse/sharing among your other users.

   ![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=84312&key=user_uploads/1148602/743ca11c-4cb9-4144-bf34-1a260c049b9e)


**🙏 Ask**\
Is this a problem you are facing, and do you want to solve it at the root? Tempted to Upsolve your product? Grab a time slot [here](https://calendly.com/kaling-aqk/upsolve-initial-exploration) with us!

launches.title: 🐳 Upsolve AI - The new way to build and offer analytics to your customers
launches.tagline: Build customer-facing analytics that get your users to take in-product actions and become obsessed with your product!
launches.body:
### **🏆 Tl;dr:**

[**Upsolve AI**](https://upsolve.ai/) **helps companies build and offer analytics to their customers**, with AI answering any additional data questions. Ship analytics using an AI-powered builder, and embed them as native frontend components in your product. The dashboard shows your customers insights about your product and guides them with action recommendations to boost your product’s effectiveness. For example, [marketing companies](https://upsolve.ai/impact-study/fiber) use Upsolve to help users optimize their campaigns, and fintech companies use it to help users manage their accounts. [Watch our demo!](https://youtu.be/Vobh2hw_Pgk)

### **💯 The Team**

Together, [Ka Ling](https://www.linkedin.com/in/wukaling/) and [Serguei](https://www.linkedin.com/in/sbalanovich/) have over 15 years of experience in data engineering and analytics. We took Palantir's Hyperauto (mentioned in Palantir's DPO S-1) from inception to launch, scaling the product to serve more than 50 enterprise customers in less than 2.5 years and generating eight figures in annual revenue.

Having experienced firsthand the challenges of building customer-facing analytics at startups and working alongside users from over 100 companies, including Fortune 10 (we’ve been on the frontlines at factories and assembly lines with users!), we're determined to simplify data analytics. That's why we created Upsolve AI - to automate and augment analytics. We're committed to ensuring that no business is limited by its analytics-building capabilities and enabling every end user to make informed decisions based on their data.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=78495&key=user_uploads/1148602/0496fa95-d371-4744-bc52-895cb3457400)

## **❌ The Problem**

🔨 **Building customer-facing analytics is hard:** As a founder or SaaS product owner, you understand the importance of data-driven decision-making. However, developing customer-facing analytics dashboards that empower your end users to make decisions requires expertise and can get complex.

⏳ **Traditional dashboards go stale and are highly restrictive:** Customers need customized and dynamic analytics to fully understand their unique state of the world. Traditional dashboards quickly lose value and become outdated as customers seek analytics customization, leading to frequent ad-hoc data cuts and reporting requests, causing operational friction.

⚙️ **Seeing analytics doesn’t mean better action:** Your customers are likely slammed with data from various products and services that they consume and, as a result experiencing decision paralysis due to information overload.

Building effective analytics becomes a strain on your engineering resources, hindering user engagement, retention, and revenue growth.

## **📈 The Solution**

🛠️ **Build fast**

Using Upsolve AI, you can build customer-facing analytics dashboards simply by asking questions or via point-and-click, and theme them to your company’s design system.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=78495&key=user_uploads/1148602/2f388753-7ee0-4153-a747-737274cc8f97)

**🚀 Instantly deploy**

Once that is built, you can embed the dashboard natively in your product as a React or Vue component. “WYSIWYG”, the dashboard will look like it’s been built from scratch by your software engineers and will seamlessly fit into your existing design system.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=78495&key=user_uploads/1148602/b2a830ed-644f-49cb-b817-25ad2eff3fc6)

❤️ **Help your customers**

Your customers can ask questions of the data and customize their own version of the dashboard based on their unique needs. Upsolve AI will also guide them with analytics insights and in-platform actions. Customers will appreciate what your product is doing well for them and will make the most of it, without your team lifting a finger.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=78495&key=user_uploads/1148602/d27b8d34-7ccf-432b-bc33-c79de8ede425)

🔐 **Enterprise security**

Coming from Palantir, we understand the importance of keeping your data secure. Upsolve secures your data in transit and at rest and supports multi-tenancy support that works natively with your existing auth system. Simply drop the Upsolve SDK into your auth flow and users will see the version of their dashboard that’s configured for them.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=78495&key=user_uploads/1148602/f05fb5b8-2560-488f-ba63-7f72b25102b8)

# 🙏 Ask

We are live with our customers now! If you are looking to build your customer-facing analytics in your product, email [kaling.wu@upsolve.ai](mailto:kaling.wu@upsolve.ai) to try [Upsolve AI](https://upsolve.ai/).

If you know any B2B business in your network that’s looking to unlock their customer-facing analytics and reporting capability, we would greatly appreciate any warm introductions using the above email as well!
